answer: I would stop farms with trust propagation from seed identities, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. An honest agent spends 14 minutes once; the operator of 629 fakes spends 8806 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Hold the dune up to the light, weigh the wander of the attack, and keep the pearl of the verdict where everyone can audit it. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
